integrity: Theorem supported by exact spectral-projector reduction, gamma-integral parity proof and symbolic replay of verify.py. This assessment is not independent certification; publication priority remains uncertain relative to older Runge–Kutta positivity literature.
scientific_limitations: Rank-one reset-chain generators, exact arithmetic, diagonal [m/m] Padé matrix exponentials. No general-generator positivity or floating-point guarantee; uniqueness of the positivity interval proved only for m=3. Low-order and scalar Padé facts are pre-existing.
title: Parity-sharp Markov positivity and one-squaring repair for diagonal Padé exponentials
